findings.body:
Gain 2, Work 1, Harm 2
Case: normal use - Client sign-off passes earlier findings through this function when it builds the next reviewer prompt (`src/forge/records.py:519`). A reviewer-reported P1 with Gain 5 or Harm 4 is now presented there as P0. Sign-off distinguishes those cases: `src/forge/records.py:491` and `:565-568` allow the owner to accept the P1 at the round limit, while an actual P0 requires repair unless the sample-data exception applies. The next reviewer therefore receives the wrong priority; if it carries that label forward, the owner loses the acceptance option. Preserve the reported priority for sign-off history.
findings.title: Follow-up: Preserve sign-off priorities in review history

why: Close lists a finding as P1 in its table and finding list while it treats it as a P0 that ignores the round limit, so the owner is offered accept and then refused (#1498)
